news_list.title: Celine Boutier wins the ShopRite LPGA 2026
news_list.summary:
Celine Boutier has won her second ShopRite LPGA powered by Wakefern title, coming back from four shots down in the final round. The Frenchwoman closed with a brilliant 66 (-5) for a 204 (-9) total on the Bay Course at Seaview, one shot ahead of Thailand's Arpichaya Yubol.

Boutier, 32, started the final round four shots behind leader Soo Bin Joo. She turned things around with three birdies around the halfway point, took the lead with a 30-foot putt on the 14th hole, and managed the final holes with great clarity, closing with decisive pars. This is her seventh victory on the LPGA Tour, her first in nearly three years, and confirms her special connection with this tournament (she already won in 2021).

Celine Boutier, results

Arpichaya Yubol finished second with a total of -8 (65-74-66). Ireland's Lauren Walsh finished third at -7 (70-69-67).

Carolina Melgrati performed well, finishing tied for 64th with a total of +3 (73-70-73). The Italian rookie demonstrated solidity, especially in the second round, confirming her ability to compete on the LPGA Tour. Benedetta Moresco, however, failed to make the cut.

The 54-hole tournament featured a highly competitive field on a short but technical course, where precision and putting make the difference. Boutier earned $262,500 and heads into the upcoming U.S. Women's Open with great momentum.

The traditional LPGA Tour event, one of the longest-running on the women's circuit, is ready to celebrate its 38th edition from May 29-31, 2026, at the Seaview Hotel & Golf Club (Bay Course) in Galloway, New Jersey, near Atlantic City. This event combines history, spectacle, and impact on the local area, with a field of 144 top-notch players.

The ShopRite LPGA powered by Wakefern, sponsored by ShopRite and Wakefern Food Corporation, is Atlantic City's most important sporting event and one of the Tour's oldest. Founded in 1986, it is played on the picturesque Bay Course, a layout reminiscent of Scottish links designed by Hugh Wilson and Donald Ross, offering bay views and requiring precision and a short game rather than raw power.

The par-71 course isn't an extreme course in terms of distance, but its strategic holes, carefully placed bunkers, and typical Atlantic coast conditions make it a complete test. In 2026, the total prize pool will rise to $2 million (approximately €1.85 million), an increase of $250,000 over 2025, confirming the title sponsor's commitment to women's golf.

The field features an excellent mix of world-class players, established champions, major winners, and many up-and-coming young players.

news_list.title: NHPC offer plugs into green energy appeal, more suited for patient play
news_list.summary:
NHPC's offer for sale is underway. Analysts suggest it offers long-term potential for patient investors. The government is divesting up to 6% of its stake. The offer opened for non-retail investors with strong demand. The floor price is set at ₹71 per share. This move aligns with global energy security focus and domestic clean energy infrastructure investments.

Mumbai: Analysts say NHPC's offer for sale (OFS) presents a mix of near-term pressure and long-term opportunity, making it more suitable for patient investors than short-term traders.

"Retail investors should look past the immediate price volatility; this is a tactical entry point into India's premier green utility franchise." said Vaqarjaved Khan, senior analyst - fundamental at Angel One.

The initial arbitrage opportunity has already narrowed as markets factored in the equity dilution, said Khan. He expects limited sharp upside in the near term due to supply overhang and long project gestation cycles, but sees NHPC as a steady compounding story driven by its transition into a diversified renewable energy player spanning hydro, pumped storage and solar.

The government on Monday announced it will divest up to a 6% stake in NHPC through the OFS route, comprising a 3% base offer and a greenshoe option of an additional 3% in case of strong demand. The issue opened for non-retail investors on Tuesday and will open for retail investors on Wednesday.

On Tuesday, the first day of the issue witnessed strong demand from non-retail investors which was subscribed 3.5 times, with bids for over 94.2 crore shares against 27.1 crore shares on offer.

The floor price was set at ₹71 per share, a discount of about 7.9% or ₹6.1 to Monday's closing price of ₹77.1 on the NSE. The stock fell 6.8% to close at ₹71.9 on Tuesday.

"

NHPC OFS comes at a time when energy security has come back into sharp focus globally," said Ankit Garg, fund manager at Wealthy Nivesh PMS. "Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, including the Iran-Israel conflict, have highlighted the risks of fossil fuel dependence, which is likely to accelerate investments in domestic clean energy infrastructure."

As of March-end, the government held a 67.4% stake in NHPC. The stake sale is part of its broader disinvestment strategy to raise resources from public sector enterprises.

Last week, the government divested part of its stake in Coal India through a similar route at a floor price of ₹412 per share last week. The government held over 63% in the PSU miner as of March-end.

news_list.title: SK Hynix Eyes Doubling Memory Chip Output Over Five Years
news_list.summary: SK Hynix Inc is a Korea-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sale of memory semiconductor products. The Company's product portfolio includes semiconductor products, such as dynamic random access memory (DRAM) and NAND flashes, used mainly in industrial electronic devices, as well as multi-chip packages (MCPs). The Company also engages in the foundry business. Additionally, the Company is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of complementary metal oxide semiconductor image sensors (CISs). CISs are used in mobile phones, laptops, tablets, medical devices, digital single-lens reflex (DSLR) cameras, camcorders, automobiles, security equipment, gaming consoles, and home appliances. The Company sells its products in both domestic and overseas markets.

news_list.summary:
SaDuring the eight plenary meeting of the Assembly of States Parties to the International Criminal Court held on 9th December 2022 at the World Forum Centre, in the Hague (the Netherlands), Mr. Sahr Lahai Jusu (Sierra Leone's Financial Secretary) was elected as a member of the Court's Committee on Budget and Finance, to serve the term jointly with Jasleen Chaona Chirembo (Malawi).

Mr. Jusu is the third Sierra Leonean elected to a senior role at the ICC in three years, following the election of Justice Miatta Maria Samba as Judge of the Court in 2020, and Mr. Ibrahim Sorie Yillah as a member (Vice Chair) of the Executive Board of the Court's Trust Fund for Victims in 2021.

The nomination, election and/or appointment of Sierra Leoneans in the international system was a key campaign commitment made by His Excellency President Dr. Julius Maada Bio of the Republic of Sierra Leone in 2018. This commitment has been reflected as part of the "Strengthening external relations for integration" chapter in the Sierra Leone's Medium-term National Development Plan 2019-2023, where the President Bio led Government committed itself to "mobilize and encourage nationals to work in regional and international bodies".

In nominating Mr. Jusu for the one seat allocated to the African States Parties on the election of the Committee on Budget and Finance, the Government of Sierra Leone expressed the view that Mr. Jusu's competence, qualifications, and prior experience, among others, at various regional and multilateral financial institutions, and being the Government's principal adviser on economic and financial matters make him valuable in advancing the principles, objectives, and values of the Rome Statute. He has the requisite competence as required of the Committee, and his nomination and election is consistent with the overall commitment of Sierra Leone to the ICC and its effective and efficient discharge of its important mandate.

The Committee on Budget and Finance examines the financial, budgetary and administrative documents submitted by the ICC to the Assembly of State Parties as part of the Court's annual budget review. It was established in 2002 by consensus to provide an appropriate mechanism for the budgetary and financial review and monitoring of the resources of the ICC.

The Committee examines and makes recommendations on the proposed program budget that the Court requests to fulfil for its prosecutorial, judicial and organizational functions, and meet its obligations to defendants and victims. The final annual ICC budget is then agreed upon by the State Parties during the ASP. The Committee meets twice annually.

Mr Jusu serves as Africa Borrowers' Representative on the World Bank IDA Committee on Resource Mobilization and Allocation.

The committee recently announced in Japan US$93 Billion financing for 74 low income countries.

【今日結論】
盤勢預期將由半導體帶動強勢開高，挑戰前波高點。昨夜費城半導體指數飆漲 5.87%，直接引爆台積電 ADR 產生高達 18.22% 的驚人溢價，此為今日台股開盤最強的定錨訊號，將有力地推升加權指數，並點燃整體 AI 供應鏈的多頭氣焰。
【新聞驅動】
AI 題材的擴散與深化是當前盤勢主軸，輝達執行長黃仁勳點名 Marvell 為「兆美元公司」，使其股價飆漲，預期將直接激勵台股相關的 ASIC、網通晶片供應鏈。然而，市場也傳出對 AI 記憶體未來可能供過於求的警訊，儘管產業龍頭如 Google 仍在大舉投入 AI 基礎建設，但記憶體族群的潛在風險已浮現，成為 AI 狂熱下需留意的變數。
【國際與台股】
儘管美股主指數僅小幅收漲，但半導體類股一枝獨秀的表現，已為台股指明方向。台積電 ADR 與夜盤期指（+3.28%）的強勁走勢，壓倒了富台指期小幅拉回的訊號，顯示海外資金對台股半導體權值股的追捧力道強勁。周邊日經、韓股同步大漲，亦為台股開盤提供穩固的區域性支撐。
【KOL與情緒】
市場情緒指標呈現分歧，CNN 恐懼貪婪指數顯示市場趨於貪婪，但加密貨幣市場則陷於恐懼。更值得注意的是，關鍵的社群情緒數據斷訊，這意味著散戶投資人的真實意向不明，盤中走勢可能更受法人機構主導。在缺乏散戶情緒參考下，操作上應更加獨立判斷，避免盲目跟風。
【操作含意】
今日操作應順勢而為，聚焦受惠於費半大漲的晶圓代工、IC 設計與 AI 伺服器等族群，預期開盤即有向上跳空機會。然而，在 ADR 巨大溢價的激情下，須留意開高後追價買盤的力道是否延續，並提防 AI 記憶體相關個股是否出現利空干擾，切勿在開盤跳漲後過度追高，應觀察盤中承接力道的穩健程度。

chart_orchestration.overall_summary: 今日市場展望極度樂觀，盤勢預期將由半導體族群帶動強勢開高，並挑戰前波高點。主要驅動力來自昨夜費城半導體指數飆漲 5.87%，此一強烈訊號直接引爆台積電 ADR 產生顯著溢價，為台股開盤注入強心針。市場主線明確聚焦於 AI 題材的擴散，預期將點燃整體供應鏈的多頭氣焰。然而，在樂觀情緒中，仍需留意 AI 記憶體長期可能面臨供過於求的潛在風險。

news_themes.label: AI 熱潮與半導體擴產
news_themes.summary: 由 NVIDIA 強勁財報引發的 AI 熱潮持續延燒，被視為產業風向標。同時，SK Hynix 等記憶體大廠計畫大幅擴產，反映出市場對半導體長期需求的信心與相關產業的積極佈局。
evidence: SK Hynix Eyes Doubling Memory Chip Output Over Five Years

news_themes.label: 經濟數據與地緣政治角力下的美元走勢
news_themes.summary: 美元走勢陷入多空拉鋸。一方面，強勁的美國製造業數據為美元提供支撐；另一方面，中東地緣政治（如美伊停火傳聞）的變化則帶來回落壓力，導致市場在等待更多數據指引前呈現盤整態態勢。
evidence: 2.美國製造業強勁，激勵美元上揚
4.傳美伊延長停火，引發美元回落
5.等待美國數據，美元普普遍持堅

news_themes.label: 印度推動綠能與政府持股出售
news_themes.summary: 印度政府透過國營水力發電公司 NHPC 的股份出售（OFS）推進其資產出售計畫。此舉被視為投資印度國內清潔能源基礎設施的長期機會，尤其在全球尋求能源安全的背景下更具吸引力。
evidence: NHPC offer plugs into green energy appeal, more suited for patient play
